title: PIC 9(7)V99 — V is an IMPLIED decimal point; the field stores 9 digits, not 10
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CHARGE-AMOUNT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> The V in PIC 9(7)V99 is an IMPLIED decimal point -- it
      *> occupies NO bytes. Storage is 9 digits (or 5 packed bytes
      *> if COMP-3). The decimal is a SCALE attribute, not a
      *> literal character. A direct port to a Java BigDecimal needs
      *> scale=2.
       01  WS-CHARGE    PIC 9(7)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1234567.89 TO WS-CHARGE.
           STOP RUN.
notes: The V is invisible in storage. Engineers reviewing the port assume 'V99' means a literal decimal point. The spec must capture the scale-2 semantic so the rewrite uses BigDecimal scale=2 (or fixed-point integers with implicit scaling).
